endpoint_eligibility.accessibility_delta: eligible as a secondary endpoint using the frozen ALT-minus-REF raw decision difference
endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction_accuracy: eligible for assay-native diagnostics after locus-cross-fitted construction; not an eQTL direction endpoint
endpoint_eligibility.eqtl_retrieval_auprc: eligible only as a variant-prior component paired with a separately registered gene mapper
endpoint_eligibility.mean_fisher_z_celltype_spearman: ineligible standalone because no target gene or signed expression-effect model exists

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Development-only retrieval audit after graph freeze; no GWAS or COLOC membership can label training sequences, set backgrounds, tune C/kernel/window choices, or supply effect direction.

gse244832.allowed_use: Held donor-compatible accessibility transfer. Different RNA and ATAC aliquots are never treated as paired cells, and no held-source peak or transform enters the fitted model.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only direction check on the preselected 20 loci. Aggregate by experimental replicate and target family; cells/guides are not independent replicates and cannot tune the model.

gse281364.allowed_use: Out-of-fold assay-native MPRA activity/direction comparison grouped by merged locus, exact sequence, and reverse-complement identity. It cannot train a signed eQTL/ieQTL head.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time scoring of evaluator-approved SNP allele windows with selection-locked project models. Outcomes, target genes, thresholds, calibrators, and retrieval labels remain evaluator-only.

gse296875.allowed_use: Train local state-specific peak-versus-matched-background classifiers inside crossed donor and genomic partitions. All fragments, peaks, negatives, sequence filters, and artifacts stay within the outer-training role.

local_model_roster.donor_pooling: Pseudobulk fragments by donor and state for QC; pool only outer-training donors for peak calling and classifier fitting.
local_model_roster.genomic_split: Cross donor folds with native-build merged LD/locus blocks and at least a 300-bp boundary buffer; honor any larger campaign-wide buffer.
local_model_roster.state_absence: Unresolved or QC-failed states are structurally_missing, never replaced by a neighboring lineage.

reference_topology_and_missingness.gse244832: Same donor, different aliquots; distinct RNA/ATAC row identities and donor-compatible aggregation only.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse281160: Guide and RNA are same cell but inference aggregates to biological experimental replicate.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse281364: DNA/RNA counts are same-sample different aliquots and failed joins are explicit missing states.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse289173: Sequence-only query; RNA and QTL summaries are same-study unpaired and never model context.
reference_topology_and_missingness.gse296875: Same-nucleus provenance is retained, but cell/nucleus count is not the replication unit.
reference_topology_and_missingness.missingness: Absent states, untestable windows, REF mismatches, held assays, and failed QC are not zero scores.

split_and_leakage_rules.donors: All wells and nuclei from one donor remain together; well is a technical batch.
split_and_leakage_rules.genomics: Merge native-build LD r2>=0.8, loci within 1 Mb, exact sequences, and reverse-complement sequences before split. Positives, backgrounds, and any MPRA rows honor the same groups.
split_and_leakage_rules.preprocessing: Peak calling, ATAC summaries, GC/mappability/accessibility/distance matching, deduplication, model fitting, and any calibration are fit only on the appropriate training partition.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_rule: Freeze and hash every final project model, allele-window rule, sign, seed, and threshold before anonymized sealed variants are opened.

relationship_to_deltasvm.shared_weights: The same fold/state/seed LS-GKM model artifacts and hashes back both adapters.
relationship_to_deltasvm.distinct_outputs: gkmSVM uses full 300-bp raw decision values; deltaSVM uses the overlapping 11-mer proxy-weight sum.
relationship_to_deltasvm.statistical_rule: Report both as related ablations and never count them as independent evidence.
